h1: Custom Flannel Blankets for Your Brand
metaDescription: Order custom flannel blankets with your logo. Soft, warm, and perfect for corporate gifts or events. Get a quote today.
introHtml: Flannel blankets offer a soft, warm feel that stands out from standard fleece or polyester options. The brushed cotton fabric provides a cozy texture ideal for corporate gifts, holiday promotions, or employee appreciation. Decorate with your logo using embroidery or screen printing for a lasting impression. Whether you are outfitting a company retreat or creating a branded giveaway, custom flannel blankets deliver comfort and visibility.
heroAltText: Custom flannel blankets with embroidered logo, soft brushed fabric for cozy corporate gifts
